title: Wire the connections and module
goal: Identify the Pro-finder connections and connect the module to the vehicle supply with the correct polarity and fuse, optionally linking it to the WiPro III (safe.lock).
prerequisites: The installation location has been selected.
The power supply is disconnected while work is carried out.
The supplied fuse and wiring harness are available.

warnings.text: Protect the positive supply lead with the supplied fuse.
Pin 6 and Pin 7 supply 12 V and may each be loaded with no more than 500 mA. Switch higher-current loads through a high-quality automotive relay with a flyback diode. Overloading voids the warranty.

steps.text: Use the connection overview to identify the four controls and the eight-pin connector: operating-mode switch (A), WiPro III connection (B), external GPS antenna connection (C) and Status-LED (D).
Connect Pin 1 (ground) and Pin 8 (permanent positive 12 V) to a suitable 12 V DC supply with the correct polarity.
steps.expected: The supply is connected and positive and ground have not been reversed.

sources.region: Section 1.2, legend for Pin 1 and Pin 8

steps.text: Protect the positive supply lead with the supplied fuse.
If required, connect loads to the outputs: Pin 7 is output A and Pin 6 is output B. Observe the 500 mA limit for each output.

sources.region: Section 1.2, legend for Pin 6 and Pin 7

steps.text: If required, use Pins 2 to 5 as measurement inputs U2 to U5. They can monitor voltages from 0 to 30 V; depending on the operating mode, Geofencing can also be activated through Pin 3.
If applicable, use the supplied WiPro III connection cable at connection B to link the WiPro III (safe.lock) and the Pro-finder.

expected_result: The Pro-finder is connected to the vehicle supply with the correct polarity and fuse. Connected loads remain within the stated limit, and an installed WiPro III (safe.lock) is linked through connection B.

error_cases.problem: A load requires more than 500 mA.
error_cases.correction: Switch it through a high-quality automotive relay with a flyback diode. A direct connection overloads the output; overloading voids the warranty.

error_cases.problem: The pin assignment at the connector is unclear.
error_cases.correction: The legend in section 1.2 gives the full assignment: Pin 1 ground (GND), Pins 2 to 5 measurement inputs U2 to U5, Pin 6 output B, Pin 7 output A and Pin 8 permanent positive 12 V. The table below reproduces it as text.

figures.alt: Annotated photograph of the Pro-finder connection side with labels A to D and numbered Pins 1 to 8.
figures.long_description: Photograph of the narrow device side. From left to right: a white rotary operating-mode switch labelled A; a black WiPro III socket labelled B; an unexplained red X over another opening; a square external-GPS-antenna socket labelled C; the eight-pin connector with Pins 5, 6, 7 and 8 above Pins 4, 3, 2 and 1; and a small green Status-LED labelled D. Additional photographs above show the WiPro III connected to B and the optional GPS antenna connected to C.
steps_text: B is the WiPro III connection.
C is the external GPS antenna connection.
The table gives the assignment for Pins 1 to 8.

change_reason: AI-assisted translation draft based exclusively on the reviewed German master. The source says to fuse the positive lead but does not assign that lead to Pin 1; the corrected master and this translation retain Pin 1 as ground and Pin 8 as permanent positive. SMS output commands remain omitted under BLK-005. Technical and independent English-language reviews are pending.
